pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Exactly THREE temporal stages of the SAME potted flowering plant left-to-right: LEFT plant with closed green flower bud, MIDDLE healthy plant with one open red flower, RIGHT plant with withered brown flower and drooping petals. A thin gray rightward arrow below the three stages denotes time. A solid BLUE dot under the MIDDLE stage, linked by short vertical blue line, marks the PRESENT MOMENT. A RED oval encloses ONLY that MIDDLE stage, and a red arrow points to the middle stage. It communicates NOW, between what has already happened on left and what will happen later on right. Earlier and later stages slightly paler, current middle stage full color. No text, dates, numbers or lettering. Whole objects and all arrows fully inside generous white margins. No people. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
